title: Designing NLP Systems That Adapt to Diverse Worldviews

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on predicting offensiveness by training on non-aggregated labels and concatenating annotator metadata (demographics and socio-political values) to the input, rather than relying on ground-truth majority voting.

Incorporating the specific political leanings of annotators (e.g., liberal vs. moderate-conservative) as input metadata to help the model learn and adapt to how different political worldviews interpret offensive language and natural language inference.
Using annotator gender (e.g., man vs. woman) alongside other metadata features to capture demographic-based divergences in how language is subjectively perceived and labeled.
